title: Pasado simple I: was / were y verbos regulares
goal: Al final de esta clase podrás decir dónde estabas y contar qué hiciste usando was / were y los verbos regulares en pasado.

sections.body:
El **pasado simple** (*simple past*) cuenta cosas que **empezaron y terminaron** en un momento del pasado: *ayer*, *la semana pasada*, *en 2020*.

Hay dos casos que veremos hoy:

1. El verbo **to be**: en pasado es **was / were**.
2. Los verbos **regulares**: base + **-ed**.

Los tres momentos con **to be**:

- Pasado: **I was** tired yesterday. (Estaba cansado ayer.)
- Presente: **I am** tired now. (Estoy cansado ahora.)
- Futuro: **I will be** tired tomorrow. (Estaré cansado mañana.)

Los tres momentos con **work**:

- Pasado: **I worked** on Monday. (Trabajé el lunes.)
- Presente: **I work** every day. (Trabajo todos los días.)
- Futuro: **I will work** next week. (Trabajaré la próxima semana.)

sections.note: Dos formas, no más: **was** (I, he, she, it) y **were** (you, we, they).

sections.h: Negativo y preguntas con was / were
sections.body: Para negar agrega **not**: **wasn't** (was not) y **weren't** (were not). Para preguntar, invierte el orden: **Was / Were + sujeto?**
sections.note: Con was / were **no** se usa did: *Did you were late?* está mal. Es **Were you late?**

sections.body:
Los verbos regulares usan **la misma forma para todas las personas**: no hay diferencia entre I, he o they.

**I worked**, **you worked**, **she worked**, **we worked**, **they worked**.
sections.note: Recuerda las reglas: *live → lived*, *study → studied*, *stop → stopped*, *play → played*. Ya no existe la -s de la tercera persona en pasado.

head: Expresión
Significa
Ejemplo
Traducción
rows: We watched a movie last night.
Ella visitó Orlando la semana pasada.
I played soccer when I was a child.

sections.note: **Ago** va después del tiempo: *two days ago*. **Last** va antes: *last week*.

sections.body:
Para contar un día completo combina los verbos en orden:

*Yesterday I **got up** at 6. I **worked** in the morning. I **studied** English in the afternoon. I **watched** TV at night.*

Los verbos irregulares como *get up* los veremos en la próxima clase.

Usa conectores simples: **then** (luego), **after that** (después de eso), **and** (y), **but** (pero).

list: Mal: *I was work yesterday.* Bien: **I worked yesterday.** (was no se mezcla con un verbo normal en pasado simple).
Mal: *She were at home.* Bien: **She was at home.**
Mal: *They was happy.* Bien: **They were happy.**
Mal: *I study yesterday.* Bien: **I studied yesterday.**
Mal: *Last year I am in Orlando.* Bien: **Last year I was in Orlando.**

vocab.es: era / estaba / fue (I, he, she, it)

vocab.ex: I visited my aunt last week.

examples.en: I was at the university yesterday.
We were in Orlando last year.
examples.es: Estuvimos en Orlando el año pasado.

examples.en: Where was he two days ago?
I worked in a store in 2020.
We watched a movie and then we cooked dinner.
examples.es: Vimos una película y luego cocinamos la cena.

examples.en: My friend called me two days ago.
examples.es: Mi amigo me llamó hace dos días.

examples.en: They arrived at the airport at 9.
examples.es: Ellos llegaron al aeropuerto a las 9.

examples.en: I played soccer when I was a child.
She visited her aunt last week.
examples.es: Ella visitó a su tía la semana pasada.

exercises.why: She va con was; en negativo es wasn't.
You usa were, y con to be no se usa did.
Study cambia la y por ied: studied.
Live termina en e, solo agrega -d.

exercises.q: We ___ in Orlando last week. (be, past)
They ___ at the party. (not be, past)
exercises.why: They usa were y en negativo weren't.
Hace dos días se dice two days ago.

exercises.es: Ella visitó Orlando el año pasado.

exercises.why: She usa was y en negativo wasn't.

speak: We were in Orlando last year.
I worked in a store in 2020.
I played soccer when I was a child.
tip: Error típico: usar presente con palabras de pasado (*I study yesterday*) o mezclar was con otro verbo (*I was study*). En pasado simple, un solo verbo en pasado: studied. Y con to be, was o were solos.
